# sspi_role_bindings (Data Source)

Lists every role binding configured on the SSPI appliance.

Corresponds to `GET /sspi/iam/role-bindings`. Returns all results in a single page (no offset/page_size pass-through). Returns an empty list (not an error) if no LDAP identity source is configured yet — the API's own `204` response for that case is treated as zero results.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The role bindings configured on the SSPI appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `entity_name` (String) The user or group granted these roles.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the role binding.
- `roles` (List of String) The roles granted to this entity.
- `user_type` (String) `LOCAL_USER`, `REMOTE_USER`, or `REMOTE_GROUP`.
